To help global physiotherapists, optometrists and nurses establish extensive careers, Academically has come up with this new interactive platform. This page is a one-stop solution for physiotherapists, optometrists and nurses who wish to migrate abroad and make the most of their careers. 

We will discuss the career options for physiotherapists, especially the Australian Physiotherapy Council (APC Exam), which permits physiotherapists to migrate to Australia. 

Another exam for which we’ll create and share informative videos is the OCANZ Competence in Optometry Examination (COE), which helps global optometrists register in Australia. 

Here, we will also talk about the NCLEX exam that allows you to practice as a registered nurse in Australia, New Zealand, USA, Canada and a few other countries. 

So, if you are an optometrist, a nurse or a physiotherapist, subscribe to this channel for latest industry updates.

Please fill up this form:
https://academically.com/contact-us/
